name: Stale Snail 53
author: AmIt-DasIT
description: 3d dark rounded gray form that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
On hover, transform becomes scale(1.05), box-shadow becomes 6px 6px 10px #000000,
  1px 1px 10px #ffffff,
  inset 2px 2px 10px #000000,
  inset -1px -1px 5px #ffffff. Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes rotateY(-180deg). On focus, opacity becomes 0, transform becomes scale(1.05), box-shadow becomes 6px 6px 10px #000000,
  1px 1px 10px #ffffff,
  inset 2px 2px 10px #000000,
  inset -1px -1px 5px #ffffff.
